data.title: Iran hangs two young men for protest-linked offences
data.description: Iran on Tuesday hanged two young men on charges related to nationwide protests in January, as rights groups accused authorities of subjecting them to torture and an unfair trial.

data.title: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police
data.description: DHAKA - Paramilitary forces were deployed in industrial suburbs around the Bangladesh capital as protests by garment sector workers demanding a wage hike stretched into their fourth day on Tuesday, defying calls to return to factories.

data.title: Foot Locker Opens New Store at Central Hatyai, Bringing Latest Sneakers and Sportswear Trends
data.description: Foot Locker has opened the newest store at Central Hatyai, featuring a refreshed store concept designed to make sneaker shopping more fun and convenient. The store features dedicated zones for running, basketball, and streetwear, along with display areas showcasing the latest sneaker releases and exclusive collections, bringing the stories behind iconic sneaker styles to life.

data.title: NIMIT Lumpini Park North Secures THB 9B Financing from Bangkok Bank
data.description: BANGKOK, Thailand — NIMITLumpini Park North (formerly NIMIT Langsuan) has secured THB 9 billion in project financing from Bangkok Bank Public Company Limited ("Bangkok Bank"), the luxury freehold wellness residence on Langsuan Road in central Bangkok, facing Lumpini Park. This financing provides a strong foundation for the project, which has a total project value of THB 15 billion and is currently 75% sold. With construction now complete, ownership transfers for sold residences are expected to commence in late 2026.

data.title: Late start for cold season expected
data.description: The Meteorological Department expects the cold season in Thailand to start later than usual this year due to the strong El Nino weather phenomenon.

data.title: China Eastern Airlines ex-chairman sentenced to 14 years for bribery
data.description: BEIJING — Liu Shaoyong, ​former chairman of ​China ‌Eastern Airlines, was sentenced to 14 years in prison over bribery, ​China Central Television ( CCTV ) reported on Tuesday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ortikov vows no repeat of fifth-round lapse in title rematch
data.description: Aslamjon Ortikov has vowed to avoid another late lapse when he challenges Asadula Imangazaliev for ONE Championship’s flyweight Muay Thai title again, admitting he eased off in their first fight because he thought he had won.

data.title: AIT showcases disaster resilience innovations
data.description: Joint symposium with the Embassy of Nepal in Thailand highlights practical technologies and opportunities to strengthen disaster preparedness across Asia.

data.title: Nene Royal transforms into young witch Billie ahead of Disney’s Hexed release
data.description: Thai singer Nene Royal unveils a Billie-inspired makeover by Homeless Makeup ahead of her voice-acting debut in Disney’s Hexed, arriving in cinemas on November 26.

data.title: Cabinet approves B45 cap on Bangkok train fares
data.description: The cabinet on Tuesday approved a Transport Ministry proposal to cap Bangkok electric train fares at 45 baht on all lines, to ease the strain on commuters' wallets as the cost of living soars.

data.title: Cabinet approves B45 cap on Bangok train fares
data.description: The cabinet on Tuesday approved a Transport Ministry proposal to cap Bangkok electric train fares at 45 baht on all lines, to ease the strain on commuters' wallets as the cost of living soars.

data.title: Chonburi's Coastal Appeal Soars as Traveloka Data Shows 20% Spike in Accommodation Searches
data.description: Fresh Traveloka data reveals a 20% spike in Chonburi searches as Thai holidaymakers rediscover the enduring charm of nearby coastal getaways

data.title: Khon Kaen Geopark passes Unesco review
data.description: Khon Kaen Geopark has successfully passed a Unesco review process is on track to become Thailand’s third Unesco global geopark, pending final approval in April next year, according to Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin.

data.title: When fake missions spiral beyond control
data.description: Netflix is going big with Overacting , an over-the-top comedy that cranks chaos up to 11, in true Thai fashion.

data.title: Chiang Mai temple chedi collapses
data.description: The top of a chedi crumbled and fell to the ground at Wat Mai Nong Hoi in Doi Lo district, Chiang Mai, on Tuesday morning, raising concerns over the stability of nearby structures.

data.title: Easy Money Group Unveils Year-End Strategy
data.description: Easy Money launches a major 3 million baht giveaway campaign, while Premium Gold Yaowarat offers gold prizes worth a total of 2 million baht, along with an additional 10,000 baht in financing per baht-weight of gold under its gold sale-and-redemption service. The two campaigns reflect the Group’s strategy to deliver greater value, expand liquidity options and give back to customers during the final months of the year.

data.title: Egyptian mummy portraits show antiquity’s piercing gaze
data.description: ROME - An elegant woman gazes out from her portrait with expressive eyes, a gilded wreath worn in her hair and a gentle, questioning look on her face.

data.title: Phuket launches new bus line from airport to Rawai beach
data.description: PHUKET - A new bus route has been added on the resort island to serve commuters and travellers between the airport and Rawai beach.

data.title: Activists’ acquittals in criminal defamation case hailed
data.description: The United Nations human rights body has welcomed a Thai Court of Appeal decision upholding the acquittal of three human rights activists in a long-running criminal defamation case brought by the Thammakaset poultry company.

data.title: Ex-beauty queen faces public fraud, money-laundering, computer crime probe
data.description: Police are investigating allegations of public fraud, money laundering and computer crime involving former Miss Thailand Panadda "Boom" Wongphudee, following a scandal over millions of baht spent by her Goodness Foundation. She appeared to place the blame on her husband.

data.title: University student 'saved' after B400K digital arrest scam
data.description: Police forced their way into a university student's room to warn her she was online to a scammer who had already cheated her out of 400,000 baht.
